head: Tethers clear the docking neck.
text: Each pod now hangs on two strands from two reels, one either side of its neck, with cross-ties between them. The old single attachment on the pod's axis would have stopped the neck meeting the cradle collar when the pod is wound home.

head: The spine is an open truss.
text: The solid 37 m tube behind the shield is now four longerons with the hydrogen feed, the lithium loop and the power bus running inside, where they can be seen and reached.

head: Radiators are thin panels.
text: The hot and cold radiators are segmented panels on headers, ribs and stay rods instead of thick slabs. Their areas and positions are unchanged.

head: The tank is carried on struts.
text: The hydrogen tank is a foil-wrapped vessel under spaced white bumper plates, held by a ring of struts at each end rather than by two narrow solid necks.

head: Pressure hulls are domed.
text: The pods and the crew module have rounded ends and small round ports. The band of glass round the nose is now ten small framed windows, and the flat bow disc is a two-layer shield of petals on a frame.

head: Pods stow for a burn.
text: With the drive running the model shows the burn configuration: both pods latched into their hub cradles, tethers on the reels and the drum stopped.
